_comment: Canonical topic-id -> per-locale heading map for the in-app manual (SDS Phase 5). The ids are FROZEN: they are the anchor contract shared by src/ui/manual.html, manual.en.html and manual.he.html, and by src/core/manual.js. zh matches docs/USER-MANUAL.md headings verbatim; en matches docs/manual/en.md; he matches docs/manual/he.md. A null locale field means the heading exists only in the other locales (currently arm64: zh source has no such section). Never rename an id; add new ones instead.
